stem: Can a 10:50 tour visitor get an audio guide before the desk closes?

optionRationales.reason: No, the Garden is closed at 12:20.：Garden 狀態不影響較早 audio desk。
Yes, because Nature has 48 visits.：圖表數值不是開放依據。
Yes, the tour begins 55 minutes before the 11:45 closing time.：10:50 到 11:45 相差五十五分鐘，仍在關閉前。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「主表或圖表提供的數值與 NOTE 限制同時套用後只剩一個可行方案」可推出 Yes, the tour begins 55 minutes before the 11:45 closing time.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Yes, the tour begins 55 minutes before the 11:45 closing time. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
